# Keine Eile

> Keine Eile ("no hurry") is an iPhone app for Vienna's public transport. It combines Wiener Linien live departures with the walk to the stop and answers one question at a glance: do I have time, or do I have to run?

Keine Eile is an independent app by Sebastiaan Arnold. It is not an official Wiener Linien app and is not made, endorsed or checked by Wiener Linien.

## Facts

- Platform: iPhone, iOS 18 or later
- Languages: English and German
- Coverage: Vienna only (Wiener Linien U-Bahn, trams and buses, plus Badner Bahn in journey planning). No S-Bahn or regional trains.
- Data: live departures and journey planning from Wiener Linien open data (CC BY 4.0); walking times and address search from Apple Maps
- Account: none. No tracking, no analytics, no advertising, no server of its own
- Availability: coming soon to the App Store

## What it does

- Shows nearby stops and favourite lines with live departures
- Works out the walk to the stop (Apple Maps, optionally adjusted to the user's own pace learned on the device from step data)
- Shows a status for each departure: "leave in X min" (green), "leave now" (orange) or "Eile!" (red: only if you hurry). From an hour ahead it shows a clock time ("leave at 07:00")
- Plans the fastest way to one saved destination (for example home or work) with the Wiener Linien journey planner
- Home-screen and lock-screen widgets, a Live Activity for a tracked departure, and Siri shortcuts ("When do I need to leave?", "Way home")
